issues.description: The template's addGuestStudents method has a different parameter list than specified in the problem statement and implemented in the solution. The problem requires addGuestStudents(int) (single int parameter) and the solution implements public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents), but the template declares public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput). This mismatch can confuse students and cause compilation/signature issues when they try to implement the method according to the instructions or compare with the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template method signature to match the problem statement and solution: change public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). Alternatively, update the problem statement to document the additional boolean parameter and provide a corresponding implementation in the solution.
